g.text: Viewstamped Replication & Remus Virtual Machine Sync
[25:48] If the primary fails before sending the log entry to backup, what happens to client state?
[26:10] The backup cannot acknowledge until it has written the transaction entry to non-volatile storage.
[26:35] Otherwise, on instantaneous crash, the new view would diverge and lose committed operations.
Primary must not reply to client until backup confirms disk persistence. Prevents split-brain state divergence.
Central viewserver assigns sequential view numbers. Only one view active per term to prevent dual-primary.
Type a Cornell cue or note at [26:10]...
